title: E1: describe(word) renders English card text (S)
description:
Feature: Card text
  Scenario: A decoded add word reads as plain English
    When the word 0x00b50633 is described
    Then the card says add box a0 and box a1 and put the answer in box a2
  Scenario: An unknown instruction gets an honest fallback card
    When a word outside the Course 1 set is described
    Then the card says it is an instruction we have not met yet
right_now_summary: The team is defining card text for decoded words and unknown instructions.
